card.purpose: Buy crypto; quantity fee may reduce received

requestFields.name: currency
requestFields.note: v1 MUST equal costCurrency; book-base FX is separate

validation: operationId required UUID for mutations that post
businessDate required YYYY-MM-DD
monetary fields must be decimal strings (no JS Number)
book base from db_meta; never default baseCurrency to transaction currency
posted path requires balanced journal in base
card.journalMapping: Core journal via runAtomicFinancialOperation when monetary
card.fx: book base from db_meta; amountInBase = amount × exchangeRateToBase
card.reversal: new inverse operation linked to original; no in-place rewrite of posted amounts
normalization: decimal-string money/qty/rate/price
canonicalize same-currency amountInBase=amount, exchangeRateToBase=1 before hash
recoveryCases: crash before commit → no durable effect
crash after SQL commit → reconcile durability_state
same operationId + same economic hash → idempotent replay
same operationId + different hash → IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
